name: algoritmos-monorepo
description: Monorepo para AALIE - Analizador de Complejidades (Next.js + FastAPI)

scripts.lint:api: cd infra && docker compose exec -T api ruff check .
scripts.lint:api:local: cd apps/api && python3 -m ruff check app
scripts.lint:api:fix: cd apps/api && python3 -m ruff check app --fix
scripts.format:api: cd infra && docker compose exec -T api black .
scripts.lint:all: pnpm run lint:web || true && pnpm run lint:api
scripts.format:all: pnpm run format:web || true && pnpm run format:api
scripts.test:api:gate: cd apps/api && python -m pytest -m "unit or component or system" -q
